priorityList: Use Power Siphon if you have 1 or fewer Demonic Core stacks.
Cast Hand of Guldan when Dominion of Argus is active.
Use Grimoire: Imp Lord, Grimoire: Fel Ravager, and Summon Doomguard on cooldown.
Cast Call Dreadstalkers on cooldown, ideally synced with Demonic Tyrant preparation.
Summon Demonic Tyrant when you have 5 Soul Shards.
Cast Implosion if you have 6 or more Wild Imps active.
Cast Ruination whenever it is available.
Cast Hand of Guldan if you have 5 Soul Shards, or if you have at least 3 Shards and Demonic Tyrant is not coming off cooldown within 5 seconds.
Cast Infernal Bolt if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Demonbolt if you have Demonic Core stacks and fewer than 4 Soul Shards, prioritizing targets that do not have the Doom debuff.
Use Shadow Bolt as a filler to generate Soul Shards.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions while your Demonic Tyrant is active.
